pay_detail: 2026 tuition was $8,000 (includes room and board for 5 weeks). Need-based financial aid is available. $60 application fee, which can be waived for families with financial need.
name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Theatre Arts Division
what_you_do: Live on the Northwestern campus for 5 weeks. Take acting, voice and movement classes, work on a crew, and rehearse a full play with professional directors. Tracks: Performance, Stage Management and Design/Tech, Musical Theatre.
who_can_apply: Students in 10th or 11th grade who will be rising juniors or seniors. Juniors get priority. The page asks for a class rank near the top 30 percent and some theatre experience or strong interest.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: early deadline January 2, 2026 and regular deadline February 27, 2026 (online form). 2027 dates are not posted yet. The home page says applications open in November.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application with the $60 fee. Then send a resume, two essays, a letter of recommendation and your transcript. Test scores are optional. The Musical Theatre track needs a third essay.
notes: Competitive and costs a lot, but the program says need-based aid is given and does not offer merit aid. Travel is not included. Not a paid program.
